summary: Mirror of u04 for shorts: the 波段跌幅满足 (swing measured-move downside target) uses a 上飘旗形 (up-drifting bear flag, a bearish relay). Only after price breaks the prior swing low is the rebound high fixed; target = rebound_high - (swing_high - swing_low). Entry is the break of the flag's lower-edge neckline (or an earlier 假突破), the broken neckline is resistance/stop, and price must not reclaim it. Cases: 台苯, 台达化, 远东新, 亚聚 and the 2011 台股 hourly trendline (假突破 at a weekly target, two overlapping downside targets).

patterns.name_zh: 上飘旗形（波段跌幅满足）
patterns.name_en: Up-drifting bear flag with swing measured-move downside target
patterns.structure: Down-leg from a swing high A (schematic 90) to a swing low B (70); a rebound consolidation drifting upward between parallel up-sloping lines (上飘旗形) to a rebound high C (75). The lower edge is the neckline. A bear-swing relay (空头的中继站), the inverse of the 下飘旗形.
patterns.entry: Short when price breaks below the flag's lower-edge neckline (schematic: neckline ≈73, short ≈72). Cases: 远东新 8/16 week ≈25.4, 亚聚 11/15 ≈30.6, 台达化 6/2 ≈13.9. An earlier 假突破 sell (台苯 6/29 ≈41.8; 台股 hourly 2/9 ≈9080) also qualifies, with the same handling for the flag break.
patterns.stop: Price reclaiming the broken neckline (站回线上). Schematic: short 72, stop 74 (≈3%). Cases: 台苯 day high 44 (≈5%), 台达化 14.5 resistance (≈4%), 远东新 long-black high 27.1 (≈6.6%), 亚聚 the 11/10 heavy-volume high 31.89 (≈4%), 台股 hourly 9159 (≈0.9%) and add-on black-K high 8754 (≈0.74%).

target.formula: target = C - (A - B), where A = swing high, B = swing low, C = rebound (flag) high; valid only after price breaks below B (跌破前低), which confirms C.

confirmation: Break of the prior swing low B fixes the rebound high and arms the target (p39).
Abnormal heavy-volume decline inside the consolidation before the break (亚聚 11/10).
Long black candle on the break (远东新).
invalidation: Price reclaiming the broken neckline (颈线跌破，就不能再站回).
A 破底翻 near the target ends the short (亚聚: cover at target or on 破底翻).

patterns.name_zh: 小时趋势线假突破（涨幅满足高风险区）
patterns.name_en: Hourly-chart false breakout at a higher-timeframe target
patterns.structure: Higher timeframe (weekly) has reached its upside target zone. On the 60-minute chart (小时趋势线), price breaks above the upper edge of a consolidation, then the first hour shows heavy volume without a rise (带量不涨) and the next session opens black and falls back below the consolidation's upper-edge neckline.
patterns.entry: Short on the fall back below the neckline (台股 2011-02-09 open, ≈9080); add on a later hourly black candle breaking the line (3/10, ≈8690).
patterns.stop: Resistance / reclaim of the line: 9159 for the first short; the add-on's stop is the opening-hour black-K high 8754.

target.formula: Swing downside targets from each rebound high once the prior low breaks: C_i - (A - B_i)

confirmation: Weekly upside target already reached (高风险区).
Heavy volume without price progress in the first hour.
invalidation: Reclaim of the neckline / stop levels 9159 or 8754.

rules.rule: The downside measured move is the inverse of the upside one: only after a rebound consolidation and a break of the prior low is the rebound high fixed and the target computable.
rules.quote_zh: 波段跌幅满足计算与波段涨幅满足计算为反向关系。如图示，自波段低点70反弹整理一段时间，回跌再破前低70，便能确定75为反弹的高点，此时才能计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Target = rebound high - first down-wave size.
rules.quote_zh: ❶自90高点跌至70低点，共跌20。❷自75高点-20＝等幅计算的跌幅满足55。

rules.rule: A 上飘旗形 is usually a bear relay; breaking its lower-edge neckline is the renewed bear attack signal; the broken neckline must not be reclaimed.
rules.quote_zh: 通常上飘旗形为空头的中继站结构，当跌破上飘旗形的下缘颈线，便可视为结束整理的空头再度攻击信号，技术面颈线跌破，就不能再站回。

rules.rule: Schematic trade: break at 73, short 72, stop 74 (reclaim of the line, ≈3% risk); while 73 is not reclaimed, target 55 (≈24% gain) — big wins, small losses.
rules.quote_zh: 如空在72，停损设74也就是站回线上时，风险约3%，反压站不回看跌幅满足55，获利约24%，这便是大赚小赔的操作方式。

rules.rule: A false breakout (break above then falling back below the line) is itself a short entry; the same short handling applies when the bear flag later breaks.
rules.quote_zh: 2000年6月29日跌落线下，假突破确立，空单进场，约可空在41.8元附近，停损设当日高点反压44元，也是站回线上时，风险约5%。达跌幅满足空单获利了结，约58%。跌破上飘旗形时的空单操作亦同。

rules.rule: Reaching the measured target tends to produce a base even when overshooting due to news (台达化 fell to 3.84 vs target 5.11 amid political shocks and three limit-halvings, then rebounded).
rules.quote_zh: 但是虽有超跌，仍因达跌幅满足后企稳打底后大幅反弹。

rules.rule: An abnormal heavy-volume drop inside the consolidation is an early warning before the flag breaks; its high is the stop.
rules.quote_zh: 2001年11月10日亚聚日线在整理区已率先出现不正常大量下跌的现象，11月15日破线上飘旗形确立

rules.rule: Cover shorts at the target zone or when a 破底翻 appears.
rules.quote_zh: 达跌幅满足附近或破底翻时，空单回补获利了结，约24%。

rules.rule: When the index is in a high-risk zone near its upside target, use 5-minute and 60-minute charts to time the reversal; the 60-minute chart is the 'hourly trendline' where trend turns are established.
rules.quote_zh: 当大盘达涨幅满足附近高风险区，此时5分钟线及60分钟的小时线，便可更精确的帮助判断反转时机，也就是所谓的转折点，尤其是小时线确立转折时趋势形成，因此我习惯把60分钟线称做小时趋势线。

rules.rule: Heavy volume without a rise in the first hour, then a black open back below the broken range's upper neckline = confirmed 假突破 sell.
rules.quote_zh: 当天开盘第一个小时出现带量不涨，隔日开盘立即翻黑跌落原本突破的整理区上缘颈线之下，技术面假突破卖出信号确立

rules.rule: Add-on short on a black candle breaking the line, stop at that hour's black-K high; while not reclaimed, hold for the target.
rules.quote_zh: 同年3月10日翻黑破线则是加码放空点，停损为当日开盘小时线，黑K高点8754点，站不回，看跌幅满足附近。

rules.rule: Each successive rebound high in a topping decline can generate its own downside target once the prior low breaks; multiple targets can cluster.
rules.quote_zh: 这波头部区震荡的盘跌中，两个反弹高点8874点及8829点，在跌破前低后，皆可计算跌幅满足。

rules.rule: Index futures are high leverage — small % moves are large gains/risks.

worked_examples.outcome: 假突破 sell 2000-06-29; bear flag break 9/19 then break of 26.5 armed target 17.6; low 16.7 then big rebound; short profit ≈58%.
Flag break 2000-06-02 (short); 7/10 broke 12.08 arming target; overshot to 3.84 (political shocks, three limit-halvings Oct-Dec) then rebounded; profit ≈63%.
Neckline break 2008-08-16 week; 8/23 week broke 23.97 arming target; low 11.18 then base; short profit ≈46%.
Heavy-volume drop in the range 11/10; flag break 11/15 (short); low 21.78 (above target 20.64) then 破底翻; short covered, stated profit ≈24%.

worked_examples.pattern: 小时线假突破 + 跌幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: 2011-02-08 heavy volume no rise at weekly target; 2/9 black open below neckline = 假突破 short; 3/10 add-on; mid-March low 8070 at targets, rebound back to ≈9220 (completing the weekly M top's second high); profit ≈5.4%-11% (high-leverage futures).

quantifiable: Bear flag: swing high A, swing low B, rebound C with B < C < A formed by higher lows/higher highs (up-sloping channel). Short trigger = close below the line through the flag's higher lows (lower edge).
Target armed only when close < B after C: target = C - (A - B).
Stop = close back above the broken lower edge (reclaim), or the breakdown bar's high / a nearby heavy-volume high; typical risk 3%-7%.
Cover at target zone or on a 破底翻 signal (close below a range low followed by close back above).

False-breakout short: after a higher-timeframe target is hit, intraday (60m) bar with volume > average and close <= open near the high, followed by a close back below the broken range top → short; stop = recent swing high.
Multiple rebound highs in a topping decline each produce a target C_i - (A - B_i); treat clustered targets as a zone.
ambiguities: Schematic stop: text says the stop point is reclaiming the 73 resistance, then gives stop 74 for a short at 72 — exact stop level (73 vs 74) not pinned.

亚聚: text says 2001年11月10日 though the chart/heading is 2011 (typo). Stated profit ≈24% does not match 30.6 → target 20.64 (≈32.5%) or → low 21.78 (≈29%); likely covered earlier (e.g. 破底翻 exit) but not stated.
Several targets were overshot (台达化 3.84 vs 5.11, 远东新 11.18 vs 13.61) and one not reached (亚聚 21.78 vs 20.64): 'near' (附近) tolerance is undefined.
台股 hourly: the 5.4%-11% range matches 8690→8219 (5.4%) and 9080→8079 (11.0%), i.e. add-on to first target and initial short to second target; the book doesn't spell this out.

Swing low B for 台苯 (26.5) vs the 9/19 flag break: the text says the flag broke first, then 26.5 broke, so the short entry precedes target confirmation — same as u04 (entry on neckline break, target armed later).
